title: Us Back Then: Photo Quiz
shortDescription: Turn your shared photos into a private quiz with friends and family.
fullDescription:
One photo. Different memories.

Us Back Then turns photos you choose into a private quiz for people you know. Create a gathering, send your room code or invite link, and see how everyone remembers the same moment.

MAKE IT YOUR STORY
Choose a photo, write a question with four answers, and add the story you want to share after the reveal. The app does not invent memories about your personal photos.

PLAY TOGETHER
Take turns writing questions in Memory Duel, let the host prepare Photo Battle, add optional party prompts, or use the untimed family mode. A question's author does not score on their own question.

YOUR PHOTOS, YOUR CHOICE
Rooms are private and entry requires the host's approval. The original photo stays on your device. A resized copy is temporarily sent to the server for your gathering. Temporary copies are deleted when the gathering ends, or expire with the room after at most 24 hours, subject to service availability. Access is blocked at expiry even if physical cleanup must retry.

SAVE WHAT EVERYONE ALLOWS
Only photos explicitly approved for saving can appear in a memory book. Export the book as PDF or HTML before leaving the completed gathering. Saved files remain on the receiving device.

No account registration is required. The interface supports English and Korean and starts in your device's preferred language, with English as the fallback.

The first release has no advertising SDK or live purchases. File exports are free in this release. AI question assistance and paid plans are not active. Use only photos you have permission to share. Sexual content, child exploitation, harassment and illegal content are prohibited.
